descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Algebra — Variables, Equivalent Expressions, and Missing-Value Equations for Numbers to 100 (C2.1-C2.3)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-2 unit on Algebra (C2.1-C2.3) framed around 'What's Missing?' — Detective Dee the Math Sleuth and Mystery Mo. Variables, missing numbers in addition and subtraction, equivalent expressions, and a capstone mystery case.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Detectives. Day 1 introduces variables as placeholders for unknowns (C2.1). Day 2 finds missing numbers in addition (C2.2). Day 3 finds missing numbers in subtraction (C2.2). Day 4 hunts for equivalent expressions to whole numbers up to 100 (C2.3). Day 5 closes with child-invented mystery cases that integrate all three skills. Each lesson includes an expanded_walkthrough covering misconceptions: variable-as-answer, no-strategy guess, role-of-variable confusion, same-numbers-different-order, and no-unknown trap.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson

10 printable teacher manipulatives plus 2 character puppets: magnifying glass variable cards (24), balance scale drawing mat, addition missing-number cards (24), subtraction missing-number cards (24), two-colour counters, equivalent-target cards (12), mystery case capstone template, number line to 100, variable anchor chart, detective poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Detective Dee and Mystery Mo
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 three-row summative rubric covering C2.1-C2.3 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 capstone
Detailed expanded walkthroughs covering common misconceptions
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers covering the C2.1-C2.3 cluster — variables, missing-number equations, and equivalent expressions.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: CRA progression. The balance scale and number line are the anchors — children solve missing-number equations physically and visually before moving to abstract notation. Lesson 1 introduces variable concepts. Lessons 2-3 build missing-number fluency. Lesson 4 generalises to equivalent expressions. Lesson 5 closes with a child-invented mystery case integrating all three expectations.
